title: Page 8
lines: “你……”难道是他多心了？
上官禹想着皇弟若是无心，他又何必日夜不懈的严防，不过还要再看看，知人知面不知心。
就在他打算放静王夫妇出宫时，一名东宫太监慌慌张张的跑进殿中，全身是血还边跑边滴着，见着皇上便下跪磕头。
“皇……皇上，太子遇刺了……”
来了！上官静与赵若瑾互视一眼。
“什么？！”上官禹惊得站起。
“一箭刺穿琵琶骨，太医已在抢救中。”太监抖着身子，仿佛还置身在一片血雾中。
“刺客呢？”上官禹先想到是刺客有没有被捉到，是不是还在宫中，而非心急如焚地赶去探看皇儿的伤势。
“跑了。”事情发生得太突然，根本没人发觉箭是由何处射出。
闻言，上官禹訾目握拳，一脚朝那太监踢去。“无能！一整座东宫的侍卫连刺客也捉不到，朕要你们何用……”
太子遇刺这只是乱象的开始，太子并未死，只是受了重伤，他经由某人布置的线索发现幕后主使是大皇子。
隔月十五，大皇子皇家围猎时坠马，断了一条腿，由于骨头断得太碎，医好了也是残废，终生跛足。
接着五皇子遭人匿报私藏龙袍和兵器，五城兵马司带人搜查五皇子的别院，果然在假山下的暗室找到刚做好的五爪龙袍以及五十把兵刃，百口莫辩的五皇子遭到收押，没多久圈禁于太庙，夺皇子封号。
过了几日，六皇子、七皇子接连出事，一个落水，差点溺毙，一个在酒楼喝酒与人大打出手，打残了一只眼，两位皇子母族竭尽心力要找出凶手，却惊闻是太子所为，要趁他们羽翼未丰前先下手铲除。
这下子结仇了，两位皇子这方也寻思报复。
皇子们的纷争进入白热化，今日我陷害你，明日你算计我，甲兄弟斗乙兄弟，乙兄弟扯丙兄弟后腿，丁兄弟咬紧甲兄弟不放，乙兄弟和丁兄弟合盟斗丙兄弟……
京城的局势很紧张，几乎到一触即发的地步。
可笑的是上官禹居然坐视不理，由着他们狗咬狗一嘴毛，他坐收渔翁之利，眼看皇子之争越演越烈。
上官禹认为自己还在壮年，要再生几个皇子并不难，等到他在位六十年了，再来考虑把位置留给谁，现在还不急。
每个在位者都有个盲点，听着文武百官高喊“吾皇万岁万万岁”，便以为自己真能活上万岁，是不死之身，想什么时候宾天就什么时候宾天，在死前一定能安排好传位之事。
上官禹的想法便是如此，他觉得自己起码还能活上四十年，所以皇子们去翻天覆地，他冷眼旁观，看谁是最能威胁到自己的人，趁未能成气候前先除掉他。
最后他看来看去，还是觉得静王最危险。
“终于要走了。”
辛辛苦苦的布置就为了这一天，效果出乎意料的好。
“早走早好，省得卷入这一团乌烟瘴气，这些个蠢蛋为了争那个位置都杀红眼，迟早杀得一个不剩。”皇家气数已尽，就看有没有一位明君出世，收拾这搞得不象样的残局。
“祖父，你们什么时候走？”看着前来送行的家人，依依不舍的赵若瑾这才知道离别有多困难。
强颜欢笑的赵老侯爷抚抚孙女的头，眼中有可疑的泪光闪动。“还要一、两年，暂时不能动，我们动了，皇上就要找你们麻烦，不妥不妥，再等等，祖父身子骨还很硬朗。”
三十万大军不好动，还要筹措粮草，在这节骨眼上急不得，各方人马正盯着兴武侯府的一举一动，他们动辄成为别人的箭靶。
“祖父，我等你来，你不要忘了我们说好的。”他哪里健朗了，早年受伤的肩胛骨不时抽痛，每每变天他就痛得连棋子也拿不稳，要她帮着热敷才好一点。
“好、好，祖父这人最守信了，才不会失信你这个没良心的丫头。”说什么一辈子不嫁，要陪着祖父，结果都成为人妇数个月了，每回一回侯府坐没多久便匆匆离开，也不知在忙什么。
赵若瑾失笑的拉着祖父的手撒娇。“祖父，我会想你的，很想很想，你是我最在意的人……”
“咳！咳！王妃，该上路了。”一只玉质纤修的手伸过来，拉开祖孙俩相握的手。
“十七哥哥，我还没跟娘道别，小弟哭了，我得哄他，大哥表情很难看，我去安慰他两句，还有爹……”没等她数完，双脚已不着地的飞起来。
“再不走就赶不上宿头了，好不容易才让皇兄愿意放我们离京，咱们就得赶紧走，免得他一个激灵发现这乱象正是我们所为，到时咱们想走就走不了。”上官静将妻子送上马车，仅让她露出雪臂与家人挥别。
“我们不会再回来了吧？”她没想到自己会舍不得住了十几年的京城，这里有不少令人难忘的回忆。
“若无意外的话，西南会是我们一辈子的家。”有她，有孩子，他不再是一个人，冷了、饿了有人嘘寒问暖。
“你想谁会坐上那个位置？”她看每个人都很蠹，下场肯定不会太好，皇家是残酷的修罗场。
“不管谁坐都和我们无关，我们的立身之地在西南，整片辽阔的土地就要靠你、我来改变。”上官静将妻子拥入怀中，轻抚她显瘦的面颊。
这段时日事多，她都忙瘦了，等到了西南再好好补补，养壮了身子才好生一个和她一样有着明亮双瞳的女儿。
“是要靠我，管他是丛林还是沼泽地，我一定要将它们一一摆平，让西南也能种出香甜的稻米。”她还有很多事要计划，没时间伤感了，赚银子她最拿手，有钱好办事。
“是，王妃厉害，本王就指望你让西南百姓过上好日子了。”有妻贤良，夫之幸矣！
“少拍马屁！说好了静王府归我管，你没在府里藏什么红袖、添香的吧！”她可不想一入府就看到一堆莺莺燕燕扑过来，娇滴滴地喊着，“王爷，你回来了！”
上官静失笑地在她唇上一吻，以鼻蹭着黛色细眉。“哪来的红袖添香，就你一个，要是有不识相的人想贴上我，来一个你杀一个，来两个杀一双，王妃威武。”
“呿！不知情的人还以为我多凶悍……”一说完，她咯咯笑起来，论起武力值，她的确很剽悍，夫不忠，杀之。
赵若瑾依偎在丈夫怀里，看着车窗外飞掠而过的景色，对即将在西南展开的新生活充满期待，她一定会努力把日子过得很好很好……
尾声 一方乐土乐团圆
十年后——
“赵永真，你在干什么？！”
一道火红色的身影由远而近，小小的黑点儿渐渐成形，一位披泄长发的美丽女子骑在红棕色大马上，手上的长鞭扬得高高的，挥鞭一甩，尘土飞扬，身后黑亮发丝因风而扬起，拉出令人艳羡的黑色飞瀑。
四蹄为白，毛色似红云，通体如杜鹃泣血，日行千里，正是闻名天下的汗血宝马，能跑上三天三夜而不知疲累。
此马叫“桃红”，为西南藩王所赐，是为王妃二十岁的生辰礼，原本只是一匹甫出生不到三个月的小母马，如今已是西南最美的风景之一，栖于不会上锁的马厩，任其如风一般的自在来去。
但若是问起静王，他会说最美的风景是本王的王妃，瞧她身姿妖娆，眼神多明亮，凹凸有致的身段是男人梦想的女神，回眸一笑，顾盼生姿，那妩媚的风情使英雄竞折腰，甘愿拜在她扬起的马鞭下。
content_en:
"You..." Could it be that he was too worried?
Shangguan Yu thought that if the emperor's brother was unintentional, why would he have to guard against him day and night, but he still had to take another look, knowing who knows the face but not the heart.
Just when he was about to let Prince Jing and his wife out of the palace, a eunuch from the East Palace ran into the palace in a panic, covered in blood and dripping as he ran. When he saw the emperor, he knelt down and kowtowed.
"Your Majesty... Your Majesty, the prince has been assassinated..."
Coming! Shangguanjing and Zhao Ruojin looked at each other.
"What?!" Shangguan Yu stood up in shock.
"An arrow pierced the lute bone, and the eunuch is already rescuing him." The eunuch shook his body, as if he was still in a blood mist.
"Where is the assassin?" Shangguan Yu first thought about whether the assassin had been caught and whether he was still in the palace, instead of rushing to see the emperor's injury anxiously.
"Run away." It happened so suddenly that no one noticed where the arrow was shot.
Hearing this, Shangguan Yuzi clenched his fist and kicked the eunuch. "Incompetent! There is an entire East Palace of guards who can't even catch an assassin. What use do I need from you..."
The assassination of the prince was just the beginning of the chaos. The prince was not dead, but was seriously injured. Through clues arranged by someone, he found out that the mastermind behind the scenes was the eldest prince.
On the fifteenth day of the following month, the eldest prince fell from his horse during a royal hunt and broke a leg. Because the bone was too broken, even after treatment, he was disabled and would be lame for life.
Then the fifth prince was reported to have secretly concealed the dragon robe and weapons. The Wucheng Soldiers and Horses Division led people to search the fifth prince's courtyard. Sure enough, they found the newly made five-claw dragon robe and fifty weapons in the secret room under the rockery. The incomprehensible fifth prince was taken into custody and was soon imprisoned in the Ancestral Temple to seize the title of prince.
A few days later, the sixth and seventh princes had accidents one after another. One fell into the water and almost drowned, and the other got into a fight with someone while drinking in a restaurant and lost an eye. The parents of the two princes tried their best to find the murderer, but they were shocked to learn that it was the prince who did it, and they wanted to eradicate them before they were young.
Now there was a feud, and the two princes were also looking for revenge.
The disputes among the princes have become intense. Today I will frame you, and tomorrow you will plot against me. Brother A fights against brother B, brother B pulls brother C’s back, brother D clings to brother A, and brother B and brother D join forces to fight against brother C...
The situation in the capital is very tense, almost to the point of breaking out.
The funny thing is that Shangguan Yu actually sat idly by and allowed them to bite each other. He reaped the benefits and watched the dispute between the princes become more and more intense.
Shangguan Yu believed that he was still in his prime and it would not be difficult to have a few more princes. He would wait until he has been in power for sixty years before he considers who to leave his position to. There is no rush now.
Every ruler has a blind spot. When he hears the civil and military officials shouting "Long live my emperor, long live the emperor", he thinks that he can really live long live and is immortal. He can be in heaven whenever he wants, and he will definitely be able to arrange the succession before his death.
This was what Shangguan Yu thought. He felt that he could live for at least forty years, so when the princes went to shake things up, he watched with cold eyes to see who was the most threatening person, and got rid of him before he could become a threat.
Finally, after looking around, he still felt that King Jing was the most dangerous.
"Finally leaving."
All the hard work was done just for this day, and the effect was unexpectedly good.
"It's better to leave early, so as not to get involved in this mess. These idiots are fighting for that position. Sooner or later, they will kill every one of them." The royal family has exhausted its strength, and it depends on whether a wise king will emerge to clean up this unseemly mess.
"Grandpa, when are you leaving?" Looking at the family members who came to see him off, Zhao Ruojin, who was reluctant to leave, realized how difficult it was to say goodbye.
Mr. Zhao, who was forcing a smile on his face, stroked his granddaughter's head, with suspicious tears flashing in his eyes. "It will take another one or two years. We can't move for the time being. If we move, the emperor will cause trouble for you. If it's wrong, please wait. Grandpa's body is still very strong."
The 300,000-strong army is restless and needs to raise food and fodder. At this juncture, there is no need to rush. People from all sides are watching every move of the Xingwu Marquis Mansion. They easily become targets for others.
"Grandpa, I'm waiting for you to come. Don't forget what we said." He was no longer healthy. The shoulder blade he had injured in his early years throbbed from time to time. Every time the weather changed, he was in so much pain that he couldn't even hold the chess pieces. He needed her to apply heat to help him feel better.
"Okay, okay, my grandfather is the most trustworthy person, so he won't break his promise like you, a heartless girl." He said that he would never marry and would stay with his grandfather, but she ended up being a married woman for several months. Every time she returned to the Marquis Mansion, she would leave shortly after sitting there, not knowing what she was doing.
Zhao Ruojin laughed and took her grandfather's hand to act coquettishly. "Grandpa, I will miss you very much. You are the person I care about the most..."
"Ahem! Ahem! Princess, it's time to get on your way." A slender jade hand stretched out and pulled away the hands held by the grandfather and grandson.
"Brother Seventeen, I haven't said goodbye to my mother yet. My younger brother is crying. I have to comfort him. My elder brother's expression is ugly. I'm going to comfort him. And daddy..." Before she could finish counting, her feet were flying without touching the ground.
"If we don't leave, we won't be able to catch up with Sutou. It took a lot of effort to get the emperor to let us leave the capital. We have to leave quickly, lest he suddenly discover that we are responsible for this chaos. Then we won't be able to leave if we want to." Shangguan Jing put his wife on the carriage, only letting her show her snowy arms to say goodbye to her family.
"We're not coming back, are we?" She didn't expect that she would be reluctant to leave the capital where she had lived for more than ten years. There were many unforgettable memories here.
"If nothing unexpected happens, Southwest will be our lifelong home." With her and her children, he is no longer alone. When he is cold or hungry, he has someone to ask for help.
"Who do you think will sit in that position?" She thought that everyone was a fool, and the end would definitely not be good. The royal family is a cruel Shura field.
"No matter who sits down, it has nothing to do with us. Our place of origin is in the southwest, and it is up to you and me to change the entire vast land." Shangguanjing hugged his wife into his arms and caressed her thin cheek.
There were a lot of things going on during this period, and she had lost weight. She would wait until she got to the southwest to replenish her body and strengthen her body so that she could give birth to a daughter with bright eyes like her.
"It depends on me. Regardless of whether it is a jungle or a swamp, I must level them one by one so that sweet rice can be grown in the southwest." She still has many things to plan, and there is no time to be sad. She is best at making money, and it is easy to do things with money.
"Yes, the princess is great. I am counting on you to make the people in the southwest live a good life." It is a blessing to have a virtuous wife and a husband!
"Stop flattering me! We agreed that Prince Jing's Mansion will be under my control. You didn't hide any red sleeves or sweet scents in the Mansion, right?" She didn't want to see a bunch of orioles rushing towards her as soon as she entered the Mansion, shouting delicately, "Prince, you are back!"
Shangguan Jing smiled and kissed her on the lips, nuzzling her dark eyebrows. "Where did the red sleeves add fragrance? You are the only one. If there are ignorant people who want to stick to me, kill one of them, kill two of them, the princess is mighty."
"Ouch! People who don't know about it think I'm so fierce..." As soon as she finished speaking, she giggled. When it comes to the value of force, she is indeed very fierce. If her husband is unfaithful, she will kill him.
Zhao Ruojin nestled in her husband's arms, watching the scenery passing by outside the car window, full of expectations for the new life that was about to start in the southwest. She would definitely try her best to live a good life...
At the end, the band is reunited
Ten years later——
"Zhao Yongzhen, what are you doing?!"
A fiery red figure came closer from a distance, and small black dots gradually took shape. A beautiful woman with long hair was riding on a red-brown horse. The long whip in her hand was raised high. When she swung the whip, dust flew into the air. The bright black hair behind her was raised by the wind, creating an enviable black waterfall.
Its four hooves are white, its fur is like red clouds, and its body is like a cuckoo weeping blood. It can travel thousands of miles in a day. It is the famous sweat-blooded horse in the world. It can run for three days and three nights without getting tired.
This horse is called "Peach Red" and was given by the king of the Southwest Domain as a birthday gift for the princess on her 20th birthday. It was originally a little mare that was less than three months old. Now it has become one of the most beautiful scenery in the Southwest. It lives in an unlocked stable and can come and go as freely as the wind.
But if you ask King Jing, he will say that the most beautiful scenery is my princess. Look at her enchanting figure, bright eyes, and curvy figure. She is the goddess of men's dreams. She looks back and smiles, looking forward to her appearance. Her charming charm makes the hero bow down and bow to her raised riding whip.
